query: WITH input AS (SELECT hl.region, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.id, hp.dependent_seq_no) AS total_population, SUM(CASE WHEN hp.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS males, SUM(CASE WHEN hp.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS females, SUM(CASE WHEN hp.age BETWEEN 0 AND 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS age_0_14, SUM(CASE WHEN hp.age BETWEEN 15 AND 29 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS age_15_29, SUM(CASE WHEN hp.age BETWEEN 30 AND 44 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS age_30_44, SUM(CASE WHEN hp.age BETWEEN 45 AND 59 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS age_45_59, SUM(CASE WHEN hp.age >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS age_60_plus FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON hp.id = hl.id WHERE hp.is_in_population = TRUE AND hp.snapshot = (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala) AND hl.region IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(hl.region) != '' GROUP BY hl.region ORDER BY total_population DESC) SELECT input.*, poly.wkt FROM input LEFT JOIN ESTISHRAF_LLM_KSA_Regions_Polygons poly ON regexp_replace(trim(input.region), '^(المنطقة|منطقة)\\s+', '') = regexp_replace(trim(poly.region), '^(المنطقة|منطقة)\\s+', '')
